query: SELECT x.rights_added AS "rights_added!", x.rights_removed AS "rights_removed!" FROM ( SELECT 0 AS kind, m.id, m.rights_added, m.rights_removed FROM org_memberships m WHERE m.org_id = $1 AND m.role_id = $2 UNION ALL SELECT 1, m.id, m.rights_added, m.rights_removed FROM project_memberships m JOIN projects p ON p.id = m.project_id WHERE p.org_id = $1 AND m.role_id = $2 UNION ALL SELECT 2, s.id, s.rights_added, s.rights_removed FROM service_accounts s JOIN projects p ON p.id = s.project_id WHERE p.org_id = $1 AND s.role_id = $2 AND s.archived_at IS NULL) x WHERE cardinality(x.rights_added) > 0 OR cardinality(x.rights_removed) > 0 ORDER BY x.kind, x.id
